name: IC Driver — SPI — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount SPI IC driver components in TSSOP packages, featuring TSSOP-16 footprints.
selection_hints: Select for applications requiring an SMD IC driver with an SPI interface.
Check compatibility with TSSOP-16 (4.4x5mm, 0.65mm pitch) footprint requirements.
Use when looking for tier A symbols from KiCad libraries such as XPT2046TS.

An interface other than SPI is required.
The PCB layout specifies footprint dimensions other than TSSOP-16.
